transform_rows_async: transform a list of dataset rows using async multithreading for image audio and video features
transform_single_row: transform a single dataset row by processing each feature cell value with storage client
handle_corrupted_images: handle PIL.UnidentifiedImageError when transforming rows and raise TransformRowsProcessingError with helpful messages
parallelize_storage_embedded_features: use thread_map to parallelize row transformation when features require storage embedding for images or audio
preserve_row_index_column: preserve the row index column in transformed rows when row_idx_column is specified
